entity_geography.text: s throughout Limerick and Clare. The purpose of this competition is to award a contract for six (6) period with an option to extend for a term of six (6) months, subject to a maximum of one (1) such extension, to deliver Contracted Training Services to Limerick and Clare Education and Training Board. Question 3: Clarification on €2.5 Million Minimum Credit Facility Requirement for Consortium/Joint Venture With reference to the financial requirement concerning the minimum credit facility of €2,500,000, kindly clarify the nature of the banking documentation required at tender submission stage.
